name: Bhavani

source.name: Nilgiri Hills, Western Ghats, near Silent Valley

sink.name: Confluence with the Kaveri (Kooduthurai)
sink.location: Near Bhavani town, Erode district, Tamil Nadu

did_you_know: The Bhavani rises in the Nilgiris and briefly loops through Kerala's Silent Valley National Park, one of India's last undisturbed tracts of tropical evergreen forest, before returning to Tamil Nadu.
Roughly 90% of its water is drawn off for irrigation across Coimbatore and Erode districts before it meets the Kaveri.
